te: A woman was punished because of a cat she confined until it died, and she entered the Fire for it: she neither fed it nor gave it water while she confined it, nor let it eat from the creatures of the earth.
n_ar: الرحمة بالحيوان دين؛ وحبس الحيوان أو إهماله ظلم يُسأل عنه الإنسان.
n_en: Mercy to animals is part of faith; confining or neglecting an animal is a wrong one will answer for.

te: Allah punishes those who torment people in this world.
n_ar: الإيذاء والتعذيب ليس قدرًا يُحتمل باسم الصبر؛ الله يتوعد من يعذّب الناس، والمظلوم أن يحمي نفسه.
n_en: Abuse is not a fate to be endured in the name of patience; Allah threatens those who torment people, and the victim may protect themselves.

te: Allah says: “I am the most free of partners from association; whoever does a deed in which he associates another with Me, I leave him and his association.”
n_ar: العمل لأجل نظر الناس يفقد قيمته؛ الإخلاص يحرّرك من انتظار تقديرهم.
n_en: A deed done for people's eyes loses its worth; sincerity frees you from waiting for their approval.

te: Whoever seeks to be heard of, Allah will make him heard of; and whoever shows off, Allah will show him off.
n_ar: استعراض الأعمال الصالحة طلبًا للإعجاب ينقلب على صاحبه؛ اجعل لك عملًا خفيًّا بينك وبين الله.
n_en: Displaying good deeds to be admired turns against its owner; keep some deeds hidden between you and Allah.

te: The son of Adam's share of zina is written for him and he will meet it without doubt: the zina of the eyes is looking, the zina of the ears is listening, the zina of the tongue is speech, the zina of the hand is grasping, the zina of the foot is stepping; the heart yearns and desires, and the private part confirms it or denies it.
n_ar: الشهوة تبدأ بخطوات صغيرة: نظرة وسماع وكلام؛ والعلاج أن تقطع الطريق في أوله لا في آخره.
n_en: Desire begins with small steps: a look, listening, talk; the cure is to cut the road at its start, not its end.

te: Lowering the gaze, refraining from harm, returning greetings, enjoining good and forbidding evil.
n_ar: حق الطريق والمكان العام: غضّ البصر وكفّ الأذى؛ آداب تحمي الجميع.
n_en: The rights of the road and public space: lowering the gaze and not causing harm; manners that protect everyone.

te: He is not of us who strikes his cheeks, tears his garments and calls with the call of the age of ignorance.
n_ar: الحزن مشروع، لكن إيذاء النفس والاعتراض الصاخب يزيدان الألم ولا يخففانه.
n_en: Grief is legitimate, but self-harm and loud protest deepen the pain rather than ease it.

te: There is no contagion and no evil omen, and I like optimism.
n_ar: التشاؤم بالأيام والأرقام والأشياء لا أصل له؛ والتفاؤل الهادئ من هدي النبي ﷺ.
n_en: Pessimism about days, numbers or objects has no basis; calm optimism is the Prophet's way.

te: Whoever takes the right of a Muslim by his oath, Allah has made the Fire obligatory for him and forbidden him Paradise.
n_ar: أكل الحقوق باليمين الكاذبة، في المحاكم أو الميراث أو التجارة، من أكبر الظلم.
n_en: Taking someone's rights with a false oath, in court, inheritance or business, is among the gravest wrongs.

te: The major sins are: associating partners with Allah, disobedience to parents, killing a soul, and the false oath.
n_ar: عقوق الوالدين ذُكر بجانب الشرك والقتل؛ وهذا يبيّن ثقل الإساءة إليهما.
n_en: Disobedience to parents is listed beside polytheism and murder, showing how heavy it is to wrong them.

te: If you swear an oath and then see something better than it, do what is better and make expiation for your oath.
n_ar: لست سجين كلمة قلتها وقت الغضب أو الضغط؛ إذا تبيّن لك الأفضل فارجع إليه وكفّر.
n_en: You are not a prisoner of words said in anger or under pressure; if something better becomes clear, return to it and make amends.

te: Do not curse fever, for it removes the sins of the children of Adam as the bellows remove the impurities of iron.
n_ar: المرض ليس عقوبة بالضرورة؛ هو تطهير، والضيق منه لا يعني ضعف الإيمان.
n_en: Illness is not necessarily punishment; it purifies, and feeling burdened by it does not mean weak faith.

te: Obscenity is not in anything except that it disfigures it, and modesty is not in anything except that it adorns it.
n_ar: الفحش في الكلام يشوّه أجمل العلاقات؛ والحياء يزيّن أبسطها.
n_en: Obscene speech disfigures the finest relationship; modesty adorns the simplest.

te: None of you should say “My soul has become wicked”; let him say “My soul is out of sorts.”
n_ar: انتبه لحديثك مع نفسك: وصف الحالة السيئة بكلمات قاسية يزيدها ثقلًا.
n_en: Watch your inner talk: describing a bad state in harsh words makes it heavier.

te: When one of you supplicates, let him be resolute in asking and not say “O Allah, if You will, give me”, for none can compel Him.
n_ar: ادعُ بيقين وإلحاح، لا بتردد؛ فالله كريم لا يُثقله السؤال.
n_en: Pray with certainty and persistence, not hesitation; Allah is generous and asking does not burden Him.

te: It is not lawful for a woman who believes in Allah and the Last Day to mourn a deceased person for more than three nights, except for a husband: four months and ten days.
n_ar: للحداد حدّ معلوم؛ الحزن يبقى في القلب، لكن الحياة تُستأنف بعد ذلك بإذن الله.
n_en: Mourning has a set limit; sadness remains in the heart, but life resumes afterwards.

te: Let none of you sell over the sale of another, nor propose marriage over the proposal of his brother, unless he gives him permission.
n_ar: احترام حقوق الآخرين في الخطبة والعمل والتجارة؛ لا تبنِ فرصتك على هدم فرصة غيرك.
n_en: Respect others' rights in proposals, work and trade; do not build your chance on wrecking someone else's.

te: Allah is pleased with three things for you and dislikes three things for you: He is pleased that you worship Him and associate nothing with Him, and that you hold together to the rope of Allah and do not split; and He dislikes for you gossip, excessive questioning and wasting wealth.
n_ar: «قيل وقال» وإضاعة المال؛ تشخيص دقيق لكثير مما يستهلك أوقاتنا اليوم.
n_en: “It was said and he said” and wasting money: an exact diagnosis of much of what consumes our time today.

te: If one of you must praise, let him say: “I consider him so-and-so, and Allah is his reckoner” if he thinks him so, and not declare anyone pure before Allah.
n_ar: المديح المبالغ فيه يضر المادح والممدوح؛ امدح بقدر وبصدق.
n_en: Excessive praise harms both the one who praises and the one praised; praise in measure and truthfully.

te: If you hear of it (the plague) in a land, do not go to it; and if it occurs in a land where you are, do not leave it fleeing from it.
n_ar: أصل نبوي في التعامل مع الأوبئة: الوقاية وعدم نقل العدوى، مع التوكل وعدم الهلع.
n_en: A prophetic principle for epidemics: prevention and not spreading infection, with trust in Allah rather than panic.

te: When the matter is entrusted to those not fit for it, then wait for the Hour.
n_ar: وضع غير الكفء في المسؤولية خراب؛ والأمانة في التوظيف والترقية عبادة.
n_en: Putting the unqualified in charge is ruin; integrity in hiring and promotion is worship.

te: Among what people have received of the words of the earlier prophethood: if you feel no shame, do as you wish.
n_ar: حين يغيب الحياء لا يبقى حدّ؛ فحافظ على حيائك أمام الله والناس، في الواقع وعلى الشاشة.
n_en: When shame is gone, no limit remains; guard your modesty before Allah and people, offline and online.

te: When the believer is given glad tidings of Allah's mercy, His pleasure and His Paradise, he loves to meet Allah and Allah loves to meet him.
n_ar: كراهية الموت طبع بشري؛ والمؤمن عند لقائه يُبشَّر برحمة تجعل اللقاء محبوبًا.
n_en: Disliking death is human; the believer, at its moment, is given news of mercy that makes the meeting beloved.

te: Satan flows in the son of Adam as blood flows, and I feared he might cast evil into your hearts.
n_ar: قالها النبي ﷺ لرجلين رأياه مع زوجته ليلًا؛ فالمبادرة بالتوضيح تمنع سوء الظن قبل أن يكبر.
n_en: The Prophet said this to two men who saw him with his wife at night: clarifying early stops suspicion before it grows.

te: When a judge rules, strives hard and is right, he has two rewards; and if he rules, strives hard and errs, he has one reward.
n_ar: من بذل جهده وأخطأ مأجور لا مذموم؛ علاج للخوف من القرار وجلد الذات بعد الخطأ.
n_en: Whoever strives and errs is rewarded, not blamed: a cure for fear of deciding and for self-punishment after a mistake.

te: A cloud comes over my heart, and I seek Allah's forgiveness a hundred times a day.
n_ar: حتى قلب النبي ﷺ كان يعتريه ما يحتاج إلى استغفار؛ فالفتور حالة إنسانية تُعالَج ولا يُيأس منها.
n_en: Even the Prophet's heart felt a veil needing forgiveness; low states are human and are treated, not despaired of.

te: By the One in whose hand is my soul, if you did not sin, Allah would take you away and bring a people who sin and then seek Allah's forgiveness, and He would forgive them.
n_ar: الذنب لا يُخرجك من رحمة الله؛ المهم أن تعود. هذا الحديث يكسر يأس المذنب.
n_en: Sin does not put you outside Allah's mercy; what matters is returning. This hadith breaks the sinner's despair.

te: My Lord, forgive me and accept my repentance; You are the Accepter of repentance, the Merciful.
n_ar: كان النبي ﷺ يرددها مئة مرة في المجلس الواحد؛ الاستغفار عادة يومية لا حالة طوارئ.
n_en: The Prophet repeated it a hundred times in one sitting: seeking forgiveness is a daily habit, not an emergency.

te: Whoever says “I seek the forgiveness of Allah, besides whom there is no god, the Ever-Living, the Sustainer, and I turn to Him in repentance”, his sins are forgiven even if he had fled from the battle.
n_ar: لا ذنب أكبر من مغفرة الله؛ حتى الكبائر يمحوها الاستغفار الصادق.
n_en: No sin is greater than Allah's forgiveness; sincere seeking of pardon erases even grave sins.

te: Allah said: “I have prepared for My righteous servants what no eye has seen, no ear has heard, and has never occurred to a human heart.”
n_ar: لمن أتعبه الصبر: ما ينتظرك أكبر من خيالك؛ وهذا يعطي للمعاناة معنى.
n_en: For someone worn out by patience: what awaits you is beyond imagining, which gives suffering meaning.

te: When the people of Paradise enter it, a caller calls out: “You will live and never die, you will be healthy and never fall ill, you will be young and never grow old, and you will enjoy and never suffer hardship.”
n_ar: لمن يتعب من المرض أو الفقد: هناك صحة لا مرض بعدها، ولقاء لا فراق بعده.
n_en: For those tired of illness or loss: there is health with no illness after it, and meeting with no parting.

te: Allah has written good and bad deeds. Whoever intends a good deed and does not do it, Allah writes it with Him as a full good deed; if he intends it and does it, Allah writes it as ten good deeds up to seven hundred times and many more. If he intends a bad deed and does not do it, Allah writes it as a full good deed; and if he does it, Allah writes it as a single bad deed.
n_ar: الأفكار السيئة التي تتركها تُكتب لك حسنة؛ وهذا يطمئن من تثقله الوساوس والخواطر.
n_en: Bad thoughts you refrain from acting on are written as good deeds; reassuring for those burdened by intrusive thoughts.

te: Allah is more delighted with the repentance of His servant than one of you who finds his camel after losing it in a desert land.
n_ar: الله يفرح بعودتك؛ فلا تتردد في التوبة خجلًا من كثرة الذنوب.
n_en: Allah rejoices at your return; do not hold back from repenting out of shame at many sins.

te: Allah accepts the repentance of a servant as long as he is not at his last breath.
n_ar: باب التوبة مفتوح ما دام في العمر نفس؛ لا يوجد «فات الأوان».
n_en: The door of repentance stays open as long as there is breath; there is no “too late”.

te: If the son of Adam had a valley of gold, he would love to have two valleys; nothing fills his mouth but dust, and Allah turns to whoever repents.
n_ar: الطمع لا يشبع؛ والرضا لا يأتي من زيادة المال بل من قناعة القلب.
n_en: Greed is never satisfied; contentment comes not from more money but from a content heart.

te: To Allah belongs what He took and to Him belongs what He gave, and everything with Him has an appointed term; so let her be patient and hope for reward.
n_ar: كلمات النبي ﷺ لابنته عند احتضار ولدها؛ تعزية تجمع التسليم والصبر.
n_en: The Prophet's words to his daughter as her child was dying: consolation joining acceptance and patience.

te: Allah says: “My believing servant has no reward with Me, when I take his beloved from the people of the world and he endures it seeking reward, except Paradise.”
n_ar: فقد الحبيب جرح عظيم؛ وجزاء الصبر عليه الجنة، لا أقل.
n_en: Losing a beloved person is a great wound; the reward for patience over it is Paradise, nothing less.

te: O Allah, forgive my people, for they do not know.
n_ar: حكاها النبي ﷺ عن نبي ضربه قومه فأدموه؛ الدعاء لمن آذاك أعلى درجات العفو، لا واجبه.
n_en: The Prophet told of a prophet struck by his people: praying for those who hurt you is the highest level of forgiveness, not its obligation.

te: (When a man said the distribution was unjust:) Who would be just if Allah and His Messenger are not just? Then he said: May Allah have mercy on Musa; he was harmed with more than this and was patient.
n_ar: حين يُتّهم الإنسان ظلمًا بعدم الإنصاف: استحضار صبر من سبقوه يخفف الجرح ويمنع الانفعال.
n_en: When accused unfairly of injustice, remembering the patience of those before you eases the wound and prevents an outburst.

te: When Allah wants good for His servant, He hastens his punishment in this world; and when He wants evil for His servant, He withholds his sin from him until He meets him with it on the Day of Resurrection.
n_ar: بعض ما يصيبك في الدنيا تخفيف لا عقاب؛ فلا تقرأ كل شدة على أنها غضب.
n_en: Some of what befalls you in this life is relief, not punishment; do not read every hardship as anger.

te: Trials continue to afflict the believing man and woman in themselves, their children and their wealth until they meet Allah with no sin upon them.
n_ar: البلاء في النفس والولد والمال ليس دليل بُعد عن الله؛ قد يكون طريق التطهير.
n_en: Trials in oneself, children and wealth are no sign of distance from Allah; they may be the path of purification.

te: There will be after me favouritism and things you will disapprove of. They said: What do you command us? He said: Fulfil the right that is upon you, and ask Allah for the right that is yours.
n_ar: عند المحاباة في العمل أو المجتمع: أدِّ ما عليك بإتقان، واطلب حقك بالوسائل المشروعة، وادعُ الله.
n_en: When facing favouritism at work or in society: do your duty well, seek your right through legitimate means, and pray.

te: You will meet favouritism after me, so be patient until you meet me at the Basin.
n_ar: الصبر على الإيثار والظلم الاجتماعي لا يعني الرضا به، بل عدم ترك المبادئ بسببه.
n_en: Patience with favouritism and social injustice does not mean approving it, but not abandoning principles because of it.

te: O people, do not wish to meet the enemy, and ask Allah for well-being; but when you meet them, be steadfast.
n_ar: لا تبحث عن المواجهة والصراع، واسأل الله العافية؛ فإن وقعت فاثبت بهدوء.
n_en: Do not seek confrontation; ask Allah for well-being, and if it comes, stand firm calmly.

te: Part of the excellence of a person's Islam is leaving what does not concern him.
n_ar: كثير من القلق يأتي من الانشغال بما لا يعنينا؛ في الأخبار وحياة الآخرين ومواقع التواصل.
n_en: Much anxiety comes from occupying ourselves with what does not concern us: news, others' lives, social media.

te: What do you think, Abu Bakr, of two whose third is Allah?
n_ar: قالها النبي ﷺ في الغار والخطر قريب؛ معية الله تطمئن القلب حين يشتد الخوف.
n_en: Said in the cave with danger close: Allah's company calms the heart when fear is at its height.

te: Whoever says, on leaving his house, “In the name of Allah, I rely on Allah, there is no might nor power except by Allah”, it is said to him: “You are sufficed and protected”, and Satan moves away from him.
n_ar: ذكر قصير عند الخروج يطمئن من يقلق من يومه أو من الطريق.
n_en: A short remembrance on leaving home, calming for those anxious about the day or the road.

te: Allah said: “Whoever shows enmity to a friend of Mine, I declare war on him. My servant draws near to Me with nothing more beloved to Me than what I made obligatory on him, and My servant keeps drawing near to Me with voluntary deeds until I love him; and when I love him I am his hearing with which he hears, his sight with which he sees, his hand with which he strikes and his foot with which he walks; if he asks Me I will surely give him, and if he seeks refuge in Me I will surely protect him.”
n_ar: الطريق إلى محبة الله يبدأ بالفرائض ثم بالنوافل القليلة الدائمة؛ لا بقفزة كبيرة.
n_en: The road to Allah's love starts with the obligations, then small consistent voluntary acts, not one great leap.

te: When the servant draws near to Me a hand-span, I draw near to him a forearm's length; when he draws near to Me a forearm's length, I draw near to him an arm-span; and when he comes to Me walking, I come to him running.
n_ar: خطوة صغيرة منك نحو الله يقابلها قرب أكبر منه؛ ابدأ بما تستطيع.
n_en: A small step from you toward Allah is met with a greater nearness from Him; start with what you can.

te: (When asked why he prayed until his feet swelled though he was forgiven:) Should I not love to be a grateful servant?
n_ar: العبادة شكر قبل أن تكون طلبًا؛ والشكر يُعاش بالعمل لا بالكلام وحده.
n_en: Worship is gratitude before it is asking; thankfulness is lived through deeds, not words alone.

te: The Fire is veiled with desires, and Paradise is veiled with hardships.
n_ar: الطريق السهل ليس دائمًا الصحيح؛ والصعوبة في الخير لا تعني أنك في الطريق الخطأ.
n_en: The easy road is not always the right one; difficulty in doing good does not mean you are on the wrong path.

te: Paradise is nearer to one of you than the strap of his sandal, and so is the Fire.
n_ar: عمل صغير اليوم قد يقرّبك جدًّا من الجنة، وكلمة صغيرة قد تبعدك؛ لا تستصغر شيئًا.
n_en: A small deed today may bring you very near Paradise, and a small word may take you far; belittle nothing.

te: The best of people is the one whose life is long and whose deeds are good.
n_ar: طول العمر نعمة إذا امتلأ بالخير؛ فالمهم ما تملأ به سنواتك لا عددها فقط.
n_en: A long life is a blessing when filled with good; what matters is what fills your years, not only their number.

te: O Muslim women, let no neighbour belittle a gift to her neighbour, even the hoof of a sheep.
n_ar: الهدية الصغيرة بين الجيران تبني الودّ؛ لا تمتنع عن العطاء لأنه قليل.
n_en: A small gift between neighbours builds warmth; do not hold back because it is little.

te: No Muslim plants a plant but whatever is eaten from it is charity for him, whatever is stolen from it is charity for him, whatever wild animals eat from it is charity for him, whatever birds eat from it is charity for him, and whoever takes anything from it, it is charity for him.
n_ar: العمل النافع يستمر أجره بعدك؛ حتى ما يُؤخذ منك بغير حق يُحسب لك.
n_en: Beneficial work keeps rewarding you after you; even what is taken from you unjustly counts for you.

te: Enough! Take on what you can bear; by Allah, Allah does not grow weary until you grow weary.
n_ar: الاعتدال في العبادة والعمل يحمي من الاحتراق؛ القليل الدائم خير من الكثير المنقطع.
n_en: Moderation in worship and work protects from burnout; a little that lasts is better than much that stops.

te: (Seeing a rope tied for support during long prayer:) Untie it; let one of you pray while he has energy, and when he tires, let him sleep.
n_ar: الراحة حين التعب ليست تقصيرًا؛ النبي ﷺ أمر بها حتى في العبادة.
n_en: Resting when tired is not negligence; the Prophet commanded it even in worship.

te: Whoever starts a good practice in Islam has its reward and the reward of those who act on it after him without anything lessened from their rewards; and whoever starts a bad practice in Islam bears its burden and the burden of those who act on it after him without anything lessened from their burdens.
n_ar: المبادرة بالخير تتضاعف آثارها؛ وكن أول من يبدأ عادة طيبة في أسرتك أو عملك.
n_en: Taking the initiative in good multiplies its effects; be the first to start a good habit in your family or workplace.

te: Whoever guides to good has a reward like that of the one who does it.
n_ar: نصيحة صادقة أو فكرة نافعة لغيرك قد تكون صدقة جارية.
n_en: Sincere advice or a useful idea for someone else can be an ongoing charity.

te: The likeness of one who keeps to Allah's limits and one who transgresses them is like people who drew lots on a ship: some got the upper deck and some the lower. Those below, when they needed water, passed by those above and said: “If we made a hole in our share we would not trouble those above.” If they leave them to do what they want, all will perish; and if they stop them, they will be saved and all will be saved.
n_ar: السكوت عن الخطأ الذي يضر الجميع ليس حيادًا؛ في الأسرة والعمل والمجتمع مصير مشترك.
n_en: Silence about a wrong that harms everyone is not neutrality; family, work and society share one fate.

te: The best jihad is a word of justice before a tyrannical ruler.
n_ar: قول الحق بأدب أمام صاحب السلطة شجاعة عظيمة؛ مع تقدير العواقب وطلب السلامة.
n_en: Speaking the truth respectfully to someone in power is great courage, weighed with care for consequences and safety.

te: When people see a wrongdoer and do not take him by the hand, Allah may soon cover them all with punishment from Him.
n_ar: ترك الظالم يتمادى يضر الجميع؛ منعه بالوسائل الممكنة واجب جماعي.
n_en: Letting a wrongdoer carry on harms everyone; stopping him by the means available is a shared duty.

te: Rights will be rendered to their owners on the Day of Resurrection, until the hornless sheep is avenged against the horned sheep.
n_ar: لمن ظُلم ولم يأخذ حقه: لا يضيع شيء؛ وهذا يخفف رغبة الانتقام ويعطي الصبر معنى.
n_en: For someone wronged without redress: nothing is lost; this eases the urge for revenge and gives patience meaning.

te: Whoever has wronged his brother in his honour or anything else, let him seek his pardon today, before there is neither dinar nor dirham; if he has good deeds, some will be taken in proportion to his wrong, and if he has no good deeds, some of the other's bad deeds will be taken and placed on him.
n_ar: التوبة من ظلم الناس تحتاج إلى خطوة نحوهم: اعتذار أو ردّ حق؛ اليوم أسهل من الغد.
n_en: Repenting from wronging people needs a step toward them, an apology or returning a right; today is easier than tomorrow.

te: (About the martyr's sins:) Yes, if you are patient, seeking reward, advancing and not retreating, except debt; Jibril told me that.
n_ar: الدين حق للناس لا يسقط حتى عن الشهيد؛ فاحرص على توثيقه وسداده.
n_en: Debt is a right of people that is not dropped even for a martyr; take care to record and repay it.

te: I am only human, and you bring your disputes to me; some of you may be more eloquent in argument than others, and I judge according to what I hear. Whoever I judge to have something of his brother's right, I am only cutting for him a piece of the Fire.
n_ar: الفوز في الجدال أو المحكمة بالبلاغة لا يجعل الباطل حقًّا؛ الحكم الظاهر لا يبرّئ الضمير.
n_en: Winning an argument or a case through eloquence does not make wrong right; an outward verdict does not clear the conscience.

te: The believer to the believer is like a building, each part strengthening the other.
n_ar: التعاون والمساندة بين الناس هو ما يجعل الجميع أقوى؛ لست وحدك في أزمتك.
n_en: Mutual support is what makes everyone stronger; you are not alone in your crisis.

te: The Muslim is the brother of the Muslim: he does not wrong him nor abandon him. Whoever meets his brother's need, Allah meets his need; whoever relieves a Muslim of a distress, Allah relieves him of a distress of the Day of Resurrection; and whoever covers a Muslim, Allah covers him on the Day of Resurrection.
n_ar: أخلاق الأخوّة: لا تظلم ولا تخذل، واقضِ الحاجة، واستر العيب؛ والجزاء من جنس العمل.
n_en: The ethics of brotherhood: do not wrong or abandon, meet needs, cover faults; the reward matches the deed.

te: The Muslim is the brother of the Muslim: he does not betray him, lie to him or abandon him. All of the Muslim is sacred to the Muslim: his honour, his wealth and his blood. Piety is here. It is enough evil for a person to look down on his Muslim brother.
n_ar: «التقوى ها هنا» وأشار إلى صدره؛ فلا تحكم على الناس بمظاهرهم ولا تحتقر أحدًا.
n_en: “Piety is here”, pointing to his chest: do not judge people by appearances or look down on anyone.

te: Help your brother whether he is a wrongdoer or wronged. A man said: I help him when he is wronged, but how do I help him when he is the wrongdoer? He said: You hold him back from wrongdoing; that is helping him.
n_ar: الولاء للصديق أو القريب لا يعني الوقوف معه في ظلمه؛ منعه من الخطأ هو النصرة الحقيقية.
n_en: Loyalty to a friend or relative does not mean siding with their wrongdoing; holding them back is real support.

te: No servant covers another servant in this world except that Allah will cover him on the Day of Resurrection.
n_ar: ستر أخطاء الناس، لا فضحها، طريق إلى ستر الله لك.
n_en: Covering people's faults, not exposing them, is a way to Allah covering yours.

te: Shall I not tell you of the people of Paradise? Every weak one, looked down upon, who if he swore by Allah, Allah would fulfil it. Shall I not tell you of the people of the Fire? Every harsh, greedy, arrogant one.
n_ar: قيمة الإنسان عند الله ليست في القوة والمظهر؛ والاستكبار هو الخسارة الحقيقية.
n_en: A person's worth with Allah is not in strength or appearance; arrogance is the real loss.

te: (Of a poor man people disregarded, compared with a rich one they esteemed:) This one is better than an earthful of the likes of that one.
n_ar: المجتمع يقيس الناس بالمال والمكانة؛ والميزان الحقيقي في مكان آخر.
n_en: Society measures people by money and status; the true measure lies elsewhere.

te: Many a dishevelled, dusty one, turned away from doors, if he swore by Allah, Allah would fulfil it.
n_ar: لا تقس قيمتك بعدد الأبواب التي تُفتح لك؛ رُبّ مرفوض عند الناس مقبول عند الله.
n_en: Do not measure your worth by the doors that open for you; many rejected by people are accepted by Allah.

te: Abu Bakr, perhaps you angered them? If you angered them, you have angered your Lord.
n_ar: قالها النبي ﷺ لأبي بكر بشأن فقراء من الصحابة؛ الاعتذار لمن جرحناه واجب مهما كانت مكانتنا.
n_en: Said to Abu Bakr about poor Companions: apologising to those we hurt is due, whatever our standing.

te: The one who looks after an orphan, whether a relative or not, he and I will be like these two in Paradise.
n_ar: رعاية اليتيم من أقرب الأعمال إلى صحبة النبي ﷺ في الجنة.
n_en: Caring for an orphan is among the deeds closest to the Prophet's company in Paradise.

te: The poor one is not the one turned away by a date or two or a morsel or two; the poor one is the one who refrains from asking.
n_ar: كثير من المحتاجين لا يسألون حفاظًا على كرامتهم؛ ابحث عنهم وساعدهم بلطف.
n_en: Many in need do not ask, guarding their dignity; look for them and help them gently.

te: Whoever raises two girls until they reach maturity, he and I will come on the Day of Resurrection like this.
n_ar: تربية البنات ورعايتهن باب عظيم من أبواب الأجر، لا عبء.
n_en: Raising and caring for daughters is a great door of reward, not a burden.

te: Are you given victory and provision except through your weak ones?
n_ar: الضعفاء والبسطاء سبب الخير في المجتمع؛ فلا تستعلِ على أحد.
n_en: The weak and simple are a cause of good in society; do not look down on anyone.

te: (The wife's right is) that you feed her when you eat, clothe her when you clothe yourself, do not strike the face, do not revile her, and do not leave her except within the house.
n_ar: حقوق واضحة للزوجة: نفقة وكسوة واحترام؛ والتقبيح والإهانة ليسا من الدين.
n_en: Clear rights of a wife: provision, clothing and respect; insults and humiliation are not part of the religion.

te: A dinar you spend in Allah's cause, a dinar you spend to free a slave, a dinar you give in charity to a poor person, and a dinar you spend on your family: the greatest of them in reward is the one you spend on your family.
n_ar: الإنفاق على الأسرة ليس عبئًا عاديًّا؛ إنه أعظم الصدقات أجرًا.
n_en: Spending on one's family is not an ordinary burden; it is the greatest charity in reward.

te: It is enough of a sin for a person to withhold the sustenance of those he is responsible for.
n_ar: حرمان الأسرة من النفقة، عقابًا أو بخلًا، إثم كبير.
n_en: Depriving one's family of maintenance, as punishment or out of stinginess, is a serious sin.

te: There is no day on which the servants wake but two angels descend; one says: “O Allah, give the one who spends a replacement”, and the other says: “O Allah, give the one who withholds ruin.”
n_ar: الإنفاق لا يُنقص الرزق؛ بل يأتي معه الخَلَف.
n_en: Giving does not reduce provision; a replacement comes with it.

te: The upper hand is better than the lower hand. Start with those you support. The best charity is from surplus. Whoever seeks to refrain from asking, Allah will keep him chaste; and whoever seeks self-sufficiency, Allah will make him self-sufficient.
n_ar: العفة عن السؤال والسعي للاكتفاء يفتحان باب الرزق؛ وابدأ بمن تعول قبل غيرهم.
n_en: Refraining from asking and striving for self-sufficiency open the door of provision; start with your dependants.
